notes.title: Steam Deck compatibility update
notes.content:
Implemented bars to have a 16:9 screen ratio in-game as well as in the menus.
Implemented support for going back in the menus using the gamepad even if it's not the gamepad used.

notes.title: Minor Steam Deck fix
notes.content: Improved Steam Deck support. Still working on that.

notes.title: Patch v1.02
notes.content:
Added option to restart a race in the pause menu
Improved AI to avoid it pulling too far ahead
Other improvements and optimizations
